test_transform_dense: test the SelectorMixin transform method with dense numpy arrays and verify dtype preservation
test_transform_sparse: test the SelectorMixin transform method with sparse CSC matrices and verify dtype preservation
test_inverse_transform: test the SelectorMixin inverse_transform method to reconstruct full feature arrays from selected features
test_get_support: test the SelectorMixin get_support method to retrieve feature selection masks and indices
test_output_dataframe: test the SelectorMixin pandas output with set_output to preserve input column dtypes
